spec.title: Network Sockstat
spec.description:
Sockets_used - Total sockets in use across all protocols

CurrEstab - TCP connections in ESTABLISHED or CLOSE-WAIT state

TCP_alloc - Allocated (established + sk_buff requested) TCP sockets

TCP_tw - TIME_WAIT TCP connections

UDP_inuse - UDP sockets in use

RetransSegs - TCP retransmitted segments

OutSegs - TCP segments sent

InSegs - TCP segments received

properties.value: Total sockets in use across all protocols

spec.title: Disk R/W Time (Reference: <100ms)
spec.description: Read/Write/IO time: seconds spent on read, write, and total I/O per partition. "IO time weighted" weights I/O-seconds by queue depth (>1 when requests overlap).

spec.title: Disk IOps Completed (IOPS)
spec.description:
Reads completed: Read operations completed per second per partition

Writes completed: Writes completed per second per disk partition

IO now I/O ops in progress per disk partition

spec.title: Disk R/W Data
spec.description:
Read bytes: Bytes read per second per partition
Written bytes: Bytes written per second per partition

spec.title: Time Spent Doing I/Os (I/O Util)
spec.description:
Wall-clock time spent on I/O per second.

node_disk_io_time_seconds_total:
Disk Time spent on I/O operations in seconds. This is a cumulative value. (Milliseconds Spent Doing I/Os）

irate(node_disk_io_time_seconds_total[1m]):
Calculates per-second rate: (last_value - previous_value) / timestamp_diff, i.e., the proportion of time spent on Disk I/O per second.

matcher.options: Idle - Waiting for something to happen

spec.title: Disk Space (EXT*/XFS/ZFS/NFS)
spec.description:
In this dashboard: Disk Total, Used, Available, Used% values are consistent with df command's Size, Used, Avail, Use% columns. Use% is rounded to one decimal for accuracy.

Note: df calculates Use% as: (size - free) * 100 / (avail + (size - free)), rounded up to nearest integer, in %.
